watch.summary: The creator laughs hysterically while watching footage of humanoid robots running awkwardly in a track race.

beats.what: Footage shows humanoid robots sprinting unnaturally on a track.
Creator points out humans aren't built to twist the way the robots are twisting.
Creator breaks down into infectious laughter at the visual.
Creator points out one robot going out of its lane and struggling to stay straight.
Creator mentions how they have to place a mattress at the finish line to stop the robots.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I don't know if human beings can run like this and live to be better.
watch.why: The sight of humanoid robots running with erratic, spine-twisting motion is inherently hilarious. The creator's contagious laughter and hilarious commentary elevate the absurd visual.
